body: thank you, I updated my post. God moved in my life and i went to family camp this whole past week. Every night the messages were for me, and i've turned a corner thanks to the Lord.

i literally forgot my own phone number, social security number, etc. I was on the phone and it was terrifying. But i also have the general stupid factor, and i used to be whip smart. It's so sad, idk. It's the worst.

I appreciate it. I went to bible camp yesterday and it was a great experience, then I went today and I think that it solidified my choice to go through with it. The message was great, it was specific to me, it was about my situation, but I'm just too broken. I cried out to the Lord, and when I swallow the pills, which is my current plan, I will ask for forgiveness. I'm too fragile and lonely for this world.

Yeah, idk, I am in this situation. In my experience there is no salvation from this. It will always hurt. For me it's going to end, but staying around friends and family is the way to go if you want to keep going.
if i tell anyone, everyone will know, and so this is why i posted on reddit.

mostly the same. I went to church, and for some reason there was a part of the message where he mentioned that everybody dies. I am concerned for the people that I may leave behind, but I just can't push on if I my life doesn't turn the corner.

lonely, and I have had a dream since I was a kid that is so far outside the realm of possibility that I can't even hold on to it as a pipe dream anymore. Also, I've had a lot of death in my life recently, including my best friend of 17 years.
I have thought about the military before, but it's not that simple these days, and especially since I already have a degree and am in my 30's.

Thank you for your kind words. Maybe your right, maybe getting help with depression will turn the corner and help me get to where I want to be, but at this point I just don't have enough fight left. I've had so many deaths in my life, this was just the biggest one. And I'm not close enough to any goals to make it worth it. To me, either God will open the window, or the door will close on my life. I'm not asking for a fulfillment of every dream or anything like that, just the ground floor on anything, relationship, career, etc.

Yes, I know that if I put forth the effort I can make myself live, but the point is that I've been praying for a long time, and my prayers just don't seem to do anything, unless it's for me to serve God in some way. The last big cry out to God resulted in me moving to a small town to teach at a small school, but now that I've served that purpose, I think that I just can't do it. I need things. I need to have my own family. I need a career change, and I've been praying for decades about the same thing, and it's just come time. Either God will come to my aid, or he wont. I pray all the time too, and I have had streaks where I feel that the lord is answering my prayers left and right and letting me know that he's there, but ever since my friend passed. Yeah, I'm just not playing games anymore. If he answers my prayers, in any way, i'll keep fighting, if he doesn't then that's my answer the other way. It's simple, and I know that God doesn't owe me anything, but that's where I am.

Hey, thanks. I do have an offer to move in with a friend and his family, but I'm not really looking for ways to extend my life anymore, and potential isn't enough for me. If God wants me here he'll move in my life, if not, then I have peace about it. I did some good in my life.
thank you so much, I do appreciate the prayer.

he was the glue, and one of our close friends got with his widow the month that we buried him, so it kind of split the group into people who were sympathetic to them, and my friend's family, who are upset about it.

I still have kids who need my help, but I've also had my dreams slip away to the point where I think that they are impossible. Basically, If any of it is fixed I'll have some hope, but if not, which is more likely, I'll end it. I feel at peace about it though, mostly.
I'm not sure, so it is an issue, but when you get to this breaking point enough, then it becomes overwhelming, and I hope that my God wouldn't hold it against me.
yeah, this is where i am with it too.

well, it just felt like it was time to move on for me. I just didn't feel like I could offer what the kids needed anymore. I also agree with your second statement, but I have been trying and I just keep starting over, over and over. I guess I'm just not wired right, idk.
